component.name: Kalendar
component.summary: A simple calendar that works with online accounts

description.p: Kalendar shows what is on by month, week or day, and keeps events in step with online calendars: Google Calendar, and any service that offers CalDAV, such as Nextcloud, iCloud and Fastmail.
Events can be added and changed without a network connection; they are sent on when there is one again.
The plugin for the calendar of Plasma’s clock no longer freezes the panel and the desktop once it is switched on. If you installed the plugin, start Kalendar once after updating: that replaces it.
Google calendars now come from the Google accounts of the system’s Online Accounts, and a lot was added around them:

ul.li: An agenda view of the next three or seven days
A click on an event shows it to read, with notes written as HTML shown as such; editing is one step further
Settings: accounts, 12 or 24 hours, the first day of the week, week numbers in the sidebar
The plugin for the calendar of Plasma’s clock can be installed from the settings
The sidebar can be put away, and shows when events are being fetched
Fetching events is several times faster

description.p: The first version: month, week and day views, and calendars from Google and from any service that offers CalDAV.
